metadata.title: Jain Source Rights Audit - SVK Corpus
metadata.methodology: Each source was evaluated against Indian copyright law (life+60 term, pre-1930 public domain by publication date, CC0/CC-BY assertions). Gate decisions from license_manifest.csv were cross-referenced with source manifest metadata. Classification into categories A-D based on: gate_state (TRAINING_ALLOWED/NEEDS_PERMISSION/WITH_CONDITIONS/UNKNOWN/NOT_ALLOWED), confidence level (high/medium/low), and source type (systems/research-only excluded). JainQQ sources (SVK-2022..2029) carry explicit 'PRIVATE AND PERSONAL USE ONLY' terms requiring permission for any corpus use.

classification_rules.A_CLEARLY_USABLE: gate_state is TRAINING_ALLOWED with confidence medium or high (R70 pre-1930, R25 expired term, R60 institution statement, R20 permissive with high confidence)
classification_rules.B_USABLE_AFTER_PERMISSION: NEEDS_PERMISSION (R92, R93 restrictive terms, R90 modern copyright) or CC-BY-NC
classification_rules.C_UNCERTAIN: WITH_CONDITIONS (R95 chronology unresolved, R30 CC0 unverified), UNKNOWN (R99), or R20 with low confidence
classification_rules.D_RESTRICTED: NOT_ALLOWED (R10 ND), duplicates marked DO_NOT_USE, or systems/research-only not actual sources

metadata.legal_basis: Indian Copyright Act, 1957. Term of copyright = life of author + 60 years. Works published before 1930 are in public domain by publication date. CC0/CC-BY assertions by third-party uploaders are not treated as rights-holder grants.

jainqq_sources.status: QUARANTINED - permission required for any use beyond private reading
